描述_EN: the figure's head is movable. this is a figure of a state official's attendant, left hand pressed against his chest. it is made with earthenware with aubergine and turquoise glaze. this type of earthenware figure was mass-produced to be buried with the deceased.
描述_ZN: 该人物的头部是可移动的。 这是一个国家官员的随从形象，左手按在他的胸部。 这是用茄子和绿松石釉的陶器制作的。 这种陶俑是大量生产的，与死者一起埋葬。
